name: MULTIMAXX — laser tag, VR and arcade
address: Bay Street Shopping Complex, Level 4, St Julian's, Malta. Phone +356 9917 7777.
hours: Daily 10:00–22:00; later visits by advance booking. Official page says walk-ins are welcome; check the booking calendar before travelling.
price range: Laser tag €8 / 1 game, €14 / 2 games, €18 / 3 games; VR €6 / 1 game or €10 / 2 games. Arcade uses €0.50, €1 or €2 coins or a PlayCard.
description: The clearest verified public gaming outing in this guide: indoor laser tag, virtual reality and coin/PlayCard arcade games. It is in St Julian's rather than Qawra and is not a PC-gaming café.
notes: Official venue page lists the address, hours, walk-in availability and rates. Group bookings and late visits need advance enquiry. PlayCard information: https://www.starwarsmalta.com/multimaxxplaycard · call +356 9917 7777.

name: The Gamers Lounge — call first for PC play
address: John Borg Street, Msida MSD 1201, Malta.
hours: Current official store hours: Monday–Friday 10:00–19:00; Saturday 10:00–13:00; Sunday closed. These are retail hours, not confirmed gaming-session hours.
price range: Current walk-in PC/console session availability and rates were not published in the pages reviewed.
description: The official FAQ calls it a gaming lounge and hardware retailer, but current walk-in PC gaming, seat availability and tariffs were not confirmed. Treat it as a call-first lead, not a guaranteed internet café.
notes: FAQ establishes the lounge/retail identity; current contact page lists store location and hours only: https://gamerslounge.mt/contact-us · An older indexed outlet page advertised timed PC/console sessions but returned 403 and has different hours: http://outlets.gamerslounge.mt/outlets/msida/ . Contact the business before making the trip.

name: Esports Plaza — status unverified
category: Gaming venue lead · do not travel without confirmation
address: Current public venue address and access could not be confirmed.
hours: Not verified; venue homepage returned HTTP 503 on 9 October 2026.
price range: Not published in accessible current sources.
description: The venue's own site was unavailable on 9 Oct and current operation/access could not be confirmed by the evidence reviewed. This does not prove closure or operation; do not plan a visit unless the venue confirms it directly.
notes: Own site returned HTTP 503; a targeted web search did not surface reliable current confirmation. An indexed Instagram profile is not evidence of current public access.

name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 — Malta LAN
category: Dated esports event · spectator access unconfirmed
area: Malta; TWC-specific public venue not stated
address: The organizer's page says Malta, Europe (LAN event). BLAST's guide for a different 2026 event names BLAST Arena Studios at MFCC, Ta' Qali; that does not verify TWC's spectator entrance or access.
hours: Organizer-listed competition dates: group stage 14–16 October; playoffs 17–18 October. Media day 13 October. Match start times and public doors are not published on the checked page.
price range: Spectator ticket price and public admission status are not published / not confirmed.
description: A professional Counter-Strike LAN event scheduled in Malta. The organizer confirms dates but not public admission, a TWC-specific venue, ticket sales or match sessions. Confirm directly before arranging transport or making a ticket-related purchase.
notes: Official event page: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ · BLAST attendee guide for a different 2026 event gives the studio address but not TWC access rules: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide · See OQ-01, OQ-02 and the transport page before attempting an event-day trip.

name: Gżira United FC vs Mosta FC
category: Local football · VBet Malta Premier League
hours: Wednesday 14 October 2026; kickoff 19:00 (Malta local time). Check the Malta FA ticket portal for changes and current availability.
price range: Adult tickets €10; senior tickets €6. Children under 16 are free but must collect a ticket at the gate. Ticket portal states €0 booking fee on listed adult/senior tickets.
description: An officially listed domestic league fixture during the trip. This match is a separate outing, not part of the TWC program. Confirm ticket availability and venue entry information before travelling.
notes: Official ticket page displayed the match, date, kickoff, stadium and ticket prices at the check time. Listing/ticket stock can change; no Qawra-to-stadium itinerary has been planned.

name: Rolex Middle Sea Race start
category: Dated sailing event · public viewing option
address: Start from Grand Harbour, Valletta, Malta; the organizer says starts may be watched from Valletta's fortifications.
hours: Saturday 17 October 2026 at 11:00. Multiple starting sequences are scheduled; timing and visibility depend on conditions.
price range: The official programme gives no spectator ticket price. A paid viewing area or special seating was not verified.
description: A major offshore-race start in a historic harbour setting. The race organizer identifies Valletta's fortifications as a viewing option; choose a safe, legal public vantage point and verify access/transport on the day.
notes: 2026 event programme lists the start on 17 October at 11:00 and describes viewing from Valletta's fortifications. Weather, exact sequence and visibility can change.

name: In Guardia at Fort St Elmo
address: Fort St Elmo and the National War Museum, Mediterranean Street, Valletta, Malta.
hours: Sunday 18 October 2026: entrance from 10:00; show 11:00–12:00; Fort St Elmo and National War Museum open to combo-ticket holders from 12:00.
price range: Adult €10 show-only; €17 including Fort St Elmo and National War Museum. Seniors/students €7.50 / €13; children €5 / €9; infants free.
description: A scheduled Sunday re-enactment with an optional museum/fort visit. Heritage Malta says the show can be cancelled for safety in adverse weather; recheck official notices and ticket availability.
notes: Official event page lists 18 Oct 2026, show time, prices and venue. It says adverse weather may cancel the event. It also lists the closest bus stop about an 8-minute walk away.

name: Picnic in the 1800s at Borġ in-Nadur
category: Dated Heritage Malta event · afternoon tea and re-enactment
address: Borġ in-Nadur Prehistoric Complex, Sqaq In-Nadur, Birżebbuġa, Malta.
hours: Saturday 17 October 2026, 13:00–16:00. Participants are asked to arrive by 12:45.
price range: Adult / senior / student / child €55; Heritage Malta members €45. Ticket availability was not verified.
description: An afternoon tea and Regency-era entertainment at a prehistoric archaeological landscape, with a guided introduction to Borġ in-Nadur. The published tea menu includes sandwiches, scones, cake, biscuits, cheese/crackers and a glass of Prosecco, plus tea, water and juice. Check dietary needs directly and confirm the event is still running before booking.
notes: Heritage Malta event page lists date, arrival time, schedule, menu, address and prices, and links ticket sales: https://heritagemalta.mt/store/e2112/ . Current ticket availability and accessibility are not confirmed.

name: CDM Sundays — 18 October
address: Café del Mar Malta, Triq it-Trunċiera, Qawra, San Pawl il-Baħar SPB 1500. Phone +356 2258 8100.
hours: Advertised event 18:00–01:00; last entry 23:00. The FAQ says party tickets are only valid after 20:00, which conflicts with the advertised start; confirm entry time directly.
price range: Online ticket release €10–€15; online ticket includes one drink token. Door tickets, if available, cost more and do not include a token.
description: A late-night poolside music event close to the hotel. It is strictly 17+ and may require ID. It runs beyond many bus schedules; plan and price a taxi return before buying a ticket.
notes: Event page lists date, ticket tiers, hours and age rule; its FAQ says entry only after 20:00, despite an 18:00 advertised start. Venue contact: +356 2258 8100; https://cafedelmar.com.mt/ · Ask the venue about the usable entry time and return transport.

name: Malta National Aquarium
address: Triq it-Trunċiera, San Pawl il-Baħar SPB 1500, Malta.
hours: Official contact page lists daily 10:00–20:00; check its live page on the actual visit date.
price range: Adults 13+: all-day €16.90 online / €17.90 at the door; after-16:00 entry €13.90 online / €17.90 at the door. Children and senior prices differ; check age/ID requirements.
description: A convenient, weather-proof Qawra activity, with more than 50 tanks and a live daily talk/feeding program on the official site. The official ticket page currently shows after-16:00 adult pricing; date-specific hours and offers may change.
notes: Current ticket page lists adult and after-16 rates; its homepage displays 10:00–20:00 and an interactive daily program. Home: https://aquarium.com.mt/ · address/hours: https://aquarium.com.mt/contact/ . Check opening-day schedules and online ticket terms before visiting.

name: Malta Classic Car Collection Museum
address: Qawra, St Paul's Bay, Malta; the museum's current landing page did not expose a street address in the reviewed text.
hours: Official site: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 09:00–14:00. Ticket shop and hours can change; call before a visit.
price range: Adult €10; child €4.50 (tax included on online tickets).
description: An indoor collection of classic cars, motorcycles and period memorabilia, described by the museum as a 3,000 m² collection. The Qawra location makes it a practical local option if the posted hours are confirmed.
notes: The museum home page lists seven-day opening, hours and prices; its online ticket page also lists the adult and child tickets: https://www.classiccarsmalta.com/museum-entrance-tickets . TripAdvisor link on the operator page is a dynamic third-party review source, not used for a score.

name: Ħaġar Qim and Mnajdra Archaeological Park
address: Ħaġar Qim and Mnajdra Archaeological Park, Triq Ħaġar Qim, Qrendi, Malta.
hours: Use Heritage Malta's current opening-hours page; no date-specific October schedule was captured in the attraction listing.
price range: Adult (18+) €10; senior/youth/student €7.50; child 6–11 €5.50; ages 1–5 free. Verify age/category eligibility at booking.
description: Two Neolithic temple complexes more than 5,000 years old, about 500 m apart, with a visitor centre and sea views. The descent to Mnajdra and the site accessibility limitations make this a poor choice for anyone who needs fully step-free access without checking first.
notes: Heritage Malta says the Visitor Centre and Ħaġar Qim are accessible with assistance; Mnajdra is not accessible. The temples are 500 m apart, with Mnajdra downhill. Official opening-hours notices: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/ · site tickets: https://heritagemalta.mt/store/c13/ .

name: Valletta — fortified capital and harbour walk
address: Republic Square, Valletta VLT 1410, Malta (Visit Malta local-council reference address).
hours: City streets and public spaces have no single attraction schedule; museums, churches, gardens and fortifications have individual hours and admission rules.
price range: No single city admission ticket or universal price; individual venues, transport and food are extra.
description: A compact fortified capital and World Heritage City with bastions, churches, palaces, cafés and harbour views. It is a useful base for the 17 October race start and 18 October In Guardia, but individual interiors require separate checks.
notes: Visit Malta's official town profile identifies Valletta as Malta's capital and World Heritage City; its page lists Republic Square and council contact. Individual attraction hours are not covered by this general profile.

name: Mdina — the Silent City
address: Corte Capitanali, Misraħ il-Kunsill, Mdina MDN 1050, Malta (Visit Malta local-council reference address).
hours: The walled city is a lived-in public place; museums, palaces, churches and cafés have separate opening hours.
price range: No single city admission ticket or universal price; individual attractions and transport are extra.
description: A small ancient walled city known as the Silent City, with medieval and Baroque architecture. Pair it with nearby Rabat only if the route and venue hours work for the day; do not assume all historic interiors are open.
notes: Visit Malta's official town profile describes Mdina as an ancient walled city and gives the local council address/contact; venue-level schedules are separate.
